messages:
Alex: hey team — proposing a lightweight CI "gatekeeper" for trace capture. aim: avoid full nsys/perfetto uploads unless the short smoke profile indicates a meaningful regression in kernels, batching, or KV-cache stats.

Maya: +1. can you outline rules? nightly currently captures everything and S3 is drowning.

Tony: seen a lot of noise for <1% token delta too. diff dashboard gets spammy.

Alex: sketch of the flow:
- per-PR: run two 2-minute smoke profiles (small and medium batch) that produce a compact JSON digest summarizing kernel totals + KV counters.
- gate decision: only schedule a full trace job if smoke-digest diff vs baseline exceeds thresholds (percent or absolute) or new kernel appears in top list. otherwise tag artifact as skipped.
- store all artifacts under s3://redwood-ci/perf-traces/{branch}/{build_ts}/ and attach tag trace-gate=kept|skipped.

Linda: how is the digest computed? need stable ordering to keep diffs sane.

Alex: digest format: sorted array of top-N kernels by total_time_ns, each entry: (kernel_name, total_time_ns, call_count, avg_time_ns, device). plus kv_hits, kv_misses, kv_evictions and hw_sig. stringify as canonical JSON.

Sam: capturing KV metrics in smoke is key. many regressions hide there. can we add miss-rate thresholds?

Alex: yes. we'll include kv_hit_rate and kv_miss_rate and compare. gate rules: flag if any kernel total_time delta > 5% AND abs delta > 1ms OR kv_miss_rate increases by >3 percentage points.

Maya: but batching regressions might be invisible with tiny batches.

Tony: solution: two smoke variants — small (batch sizes 1,2,4) and medium (batch size 32). run both and concatenate digests.

Alex: updated flow:
- per-PR: smoke-small + smoke-mod, 2 runs each. produce combined digest.
- compare pairwise with baseline; pass/fail per thresholds.

Linda: paste a CI config snippet so infra can wire this up.

Alex: sample ci/perf-gate.yaml:
``
version: 1
runs:
  - name: smoke-small
    batch_sizes: [1,2,4]
    seq_len: 64
    harness: smoke_profile
  - name: smoke-mod
    batch_sizes: [32]
    seq_len: 128
    harness: smoke_profile
artifact_store: s3://redwood-ci/perf-traces
compare_thresholds:
  kernel_percent: 5
  kernel_absolute_ns: 1000000
  kv_miss_pp: 3
policy:
  on_threshold_exceed: schedule_full_trace
  on_full_trace_fail: fail_build_optional
``

Sam: who triggers the full nsys/perfetto capture? we can't run them for every gate hit without throttling.

Alex: the gate will enqueue a full-trace job into perf-queue with priority=high. perf-queue enforces concurrency limits (e.g., max 4). full-trace runs on dedicated perf fleet. if the full trace confirms a regression, perf-bot labels the PR perf/regression and posts a short report with links.

perf-bot: [perf-bot] noted 0# Enqueue behavior implemented as PERF-921 ticket (placeholder). will post summary diffs after full-trace.

Maya: retention policy? we need to cap storage costs.

Tony: retention tiers proposal:
- smoke digests: 30 days
- full traces: 90 days
- confirmed regressions: 1 year (move to cold archive after 90 days)

Linda: hardware variance causes false positives. baselines must be pinned to hw signature.

Alex: include hw_sig = gpu_model|driver_version|cuda_version|instance_type in digest. only diff against matching hw_sig. if mismatch, route to manual-review and enqueue full-trace run.

Sam: dashboard: can we show kernel timelines side-by-side and per-kernel heatmaps? that's the most useful view.

Alex: yes. ingest digest + full nsys timeline (simplified JSON) and render heatmap + top-k kernel rows with callbars. provide permalink to S3 nsys file.

Maya: rollout plan?

Alex: phased rollout:
1) build smoke harness + digest producer (2w)
2) CI gate + S3 wiring (1w)
3) perf-queue + perf-bot integration (1w)
4) dashboard ingestion + UI (2w)

Tony: risk: PRs touching batching/quantization might need longer, more representative fixtures. propose a `/perf run fixture=long-context` magic command to trigger targeted smoke or full traces.

Alex: yep, add perf-run maintainer command. also recommend an opt-in field in PR body for custom fixtures.

perf-bot: [perf-bot] created ticket PERF-921: implement ci-trace-gatekeeper (assigned to Alex).

Linda: LGTM. infra next: S3 role + small EC2 fleet for smoke runs and a perf fleet for full traces.

Alex: assigning myself for harness + digest. tagging @eng-infra for S3/queue. thanks all :thumbsup:
